categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in power generation and supply, including coal-fired power, hydropower, wind power, photovoltaic power, and heat supply. It also engages in coal sales, power grid operations, new energy projects, high-tech and environmental protection industries, and related technical services. The business is segmented into coal, thermal power, hydropower, new energy, technology and environmental protection, and other sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced coal-fired power technologies with a focus on low-carbon transformation, including flexible operation and energy-saving upgrades. It utilizes hydropower development with digital tools like remote sensing and hydrological simulation for optimized planning. The new energy segment emphasizes cost reduction and market competitiveness in wind and photovoltaic power. The company also invests in R&D for clean coal technologies, CCUS, digital power plant management, and integrated energy solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include regional power grid companies across 29 provinces in China, industrial parks, urban communities, and energy users. The company serves the national electricity market with a focus on stable power supply and participates actively in electricity market trading. It also provides integrated energy services to industrial and residential customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in China, covering 29 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. Major operational bases include Northeast China, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has significant assets and projects in provinces like Liaoning, Hebei, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Sichuan, and Hainan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and heat supply. It also engages in upstream coal sales and procurement but mainly functions as a power producer and energy service provider within the electricity market.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating low-carbon transformation of coal-fired power, expanding high-quality renewable energy capacity, and integrating new energy into the power system. The company emphasizes innovation in clean coal technologies, digital power plant management, CCUS, and comprehensive energy services. R&D investments focus on enhancing efficiency, flexibility, and environmental performance of power assets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electricity and heat, including market-based electricity trading. Additional income streams include coal sales, government subsidies, investment income from equity holdings, and leasing income. The company also earns from technology services and environmental protection products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a subsidiary of the State-owned China Energy Investment Corporation, the company is a leading national power producer with a strong position in coal-fired and renewable energy sectors. It competes with other major state-owned power groups such as China Huaneng Group, China Datang Corporation, and China Huadian Corporation. The company leverages its scale, diversified energy mix, and integration with the national energy group to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 179.18 billion, a slight decrease of 1% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 75.28% to RMB 9.83 billion. Total assets reached nearly RMB 494 billion, growing 7.87% from the previous year. The company’s installed capacity increased by 6.12 GW, with significant growth in renewable energy assets. Cash flow from operations improved by 30.66%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory with enhanced profitability and asset base expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes reliable and stable energy supply with a diversified energy portfolio including coal, hydro, wind, and solar power. It differentiates through advanced low-carbon coal technologies, integrated energy solutions, and active participation in electricity market reforms. Its scale, geographic coverage, and state backing provide competitive advantages in cost control, technology innovation, and market responsiveness, delivering sustainable value to customers and shareholders.
